question: What mantra elements must be written at the end of the petal?
premises: An octad of mantra seeds is to be written
The writing is at the end on the petal
The syllable phaṭ is added again
inference: The octad of mantra seeds and the syllable phaṭ should be written at the end of the petal
plain_english: The octad of mantra seeds is to be written at the end on the petal, and again phaṭ.
